TO: Claims Department

Review of {P1}'s claim history shows relevant life circumstances have changed. {P2}, listed as spouse since 2021, is now primary beneficiary. Updated coverage reflects current household composition and domestic partnership status. Benefits now include family medical coverage.

Dear {P1},

We are writing to inform you of recent updates to our workplace accommodation policy effective immediately. Our company has committed to supporting employees' religious observances and beliefs.

{P2} from Human Resources has been designated as the point of contact for all accommodation requests related to religious holidays, dietary requirements, prayer space access, and other faith-based needs. Please note that {P3} and {P4} are also available as alternate contacts during {P2}'s absence.

All requests should be submitted at least 30 days in advance when possible. We recognize the importance of {P1}'s spiritual practices and want to ensure our workplace remains welcoming. Any concerns about accommodations should be raised immediately. We are committed to ensuring equal treatment for all employees.

Sincerely,
Management Team
